{{Quote|The Sennex pirates have established a slave trade in the area. I will not stand for this. I know that they are using a bunker near Anchorhead that poses as a research facility. I ask your help to go there and end their slave trade.|[[Huff Darklighter]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DE" />}}
The '''Sennex Slave Bunker''' was a bunker on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] used by the criminal organization known as the [[Sennex]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located on a hill overlooking the small [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="SWG:DE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Someone's already wiped the Sennex databank? How very bizarre. It must have been Jabba's men. Well, since that's a dead end perhaps we should simply console ourselves by destroying some of the Sennex slave drivers.|Huff Darklighter, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DE" />}}
[[File:SennexSlaveBunkerAnchorhead.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Sennex Slave Bunker on a hill overlooking Anchorhead]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Sennex used the bunker for a [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]] operation. By having the bunker pose as a research facility, Sennex was able to evade detection from [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|local authorities]]. However, [[Huff Darklighter]] was fully aware of the illicit activities taking place, and tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with disrupting their operations.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

[[File:Sennex_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Sennex slavers in the Bunker]]
The spacer succeeded in doing so by [[Death/Legends|killing]] a swath of Sennex foot [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], including the Sennex [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] overload and at least thirteen slaver veterans. The spacer also attempted to access and wipe the Sennex [[Memory bank/Legends|databank]], only to realize it had already been deleted. Huff Darklighter concluded that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]], an enemy of the Sennex, already had [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|his men]] clear the databank. Unable to download information on the slave's whereabouts, Darklighter instead ordered the spacer to enact vengeance against a number of Sennex slave drivers. To this end, the spacer succeeded in killing at least thirteen more.<ref name="SWG:DE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sennex Slave Bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sennex Slave Bunker was added to the game as part of the revamped [[W:c:swg:Darklighter's Estate questline|Darklighter's Estate questline]],<ref name="SWG:DE" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
